units.source_text: 权中纳言的女儿于本年八月入宫，为冷泉帝之女御。

en.t: The Acting Middle Counselor's daughter entered the palace in the eighth month of this year and became a consort of Emperor Reizei.

units.source_text: 其祖父太政大臣躬亲照料一切，仪式十分隆重。

en.t: Her grandfather, the Grand Minister, personally took charge of everything, and the ceremony was extremely magnificent.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王家的二女公子亦有入宫之志，

en.t: The second daughter of the Prince Minister of War's household also hoped to enter the palace,
and her parents devoted themselves carefully to her upbringing,
so her excellent reputation spread widely through the world.

units.source_text: 但源氏内大臣不相信这二女公子胜于别人。

en.t: But Genji, the Inner Minister, did not believe that this second daughter was superior to others.
The prince could do nothing about it.
